slides.texte_overlay:
5 body language mistakes that
kill your charisma in a room
Mistake 1: talking with your hands too much. Big, fast gestures look nervous. Keep your hands calm and use one clear gesture to support your most important point.
Mistake 2: checking your phone while someone talks. Even a glance says "you bore me." Leave it in your pocket and give people your full, steady attention.
Mistake 3: blocking yourself behind objects. A bag on your lap, a laptop in front of you, a glass at chest height. Clear the space between you and the other person.
Mistake 4: standing with your weight on one hip. It looks bored and impatient. Balance on both feet, slightly apart, and you instantly look grounded and present.
Mistake 5: rushing your exit. Turning away mid-sentence feels cold. Finish the moment, smile, say a proper goodbye, and leave the conversation on a high note.
Try this for 30 days: five minutes a day of history, art or science. A calmer, more curious mind shows up in your face and body long before you speak.
slides.texte_sophia: Try this for 30 days: five minutes a day on a micro-learning app like the Sophia app. History, art, science. A calmer, more curious mind shows in your body.

slides.texte_overlay: The fix: pick one mistake a week. Notice it, correct it, repeat. Body language changes slowly, but after five weeks people will see a different man walk in.
